payload.purpose_context: Lane branch names are derived two ways during merge (with and without the mission identity), so a legacy mission whose identity was backfilled can have spec-kitty merge refuse a legitimate merge with no operator remedy (#5108). This mission converges lane naming on the single authority that creates the branches, threads it through every merge stage, and closes the defect class with an enforced gate.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make every merge stage agree on a lane's branch name so legitimate merges of legacy missions stop being refused.

payload.question: A merge interrupted under the old code can resume with an empty lane-tip record. What should resume do?

payload.final_answer: Refuse, name remedy (merge --abort); fail-closed like the coordination base anchor

payload.question: How far should the one-authority rule reach?

payload.final_answer: Compose + match: route composition and hand-rolled matchers through the naming module; gate covers both
